Name: Mizu's Snake
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Ssslithering it's way into your coops, here comes the snake! If you like all things about danger noodles, this mod is for you. It adds snakes as a new [b]coop [/b]animal.

[list]
[*]Snakes lay [b]Snake Eggs[/b] every four days. It's great for making [b]Snake Mayonnaise [/b]or [b]Snake Oil.[/b][/*]
[*]Snakes drop [b]Snake Skin[/b] at high friendship. Use it to make [b]Snake Wine.[/b][/*]
[*]Up to three cooking recipes to find from the [b]Night Market. [/b](Two from snakes, one from tsuchinoko.)[/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the [b]Special Order: Solid Snake.[/b][/*]
[*](Optional) Tsuchinoko lay [b]Tsuchinoko Eggs[/b] every five days and also drop [b]Snake Skin[/b] at high friendship. Their eggs can be made into [b]Tsuchinoko Tonic[/b] in the [b]Oil Maker.[/b][/*]
[*](Optional) [b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the same special order which unlocks snakes.[/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with up to 3 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ snake or tsuchinoko meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Tsuchinoko is disabled. By default the Green and Black Snake appearances are enabled and the name is set to "Snake." You can toggle on more below.

[b]Name Options[/b] ("Snake" by default)[b]:[/b] Allows you to choose which name the animal species is called in-game. Options: Snake, Boa, Python.
[b]Enable Tsuchinoko [/b](false by default): Enables the Tsuchinoko content.
[b]Enable Blue Snake [/b](false by default): Enables the Blue Snake texture and adds it to the possible snake appearances.
[b]Enable Brown Snake [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Brown Snake texture and adds it to the possible snake appearances.
[b]Enable White Snake [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the White Snake texture and adds it to the possible snake appearances.
[b]Enable Yellow Snake [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Yellow Snake texture and adds it to the possible snake appearances.
[b]Enable Aggressive Snakes[/b] (false by default): Makes snakes and tsuchinoko aggressive and deal damage until you befriend them to two hearts.
[b]Disable Snake Wine [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Disables the rule in the keg for snake wine.
[b]Disable Special Order [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Disables the Special Order to unlock animals at Marnie's. Turn on to have Marnie sell animals by default provided the appropriate housing is built.
[b]Disable Meat Recipes[/b] (false by default)[b]:[/b] Disables meat-based recipes/books. Primarily for users who play with Animal Husbandry without having meat/butchering turned on.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
